==== varianceAnnotationMarkerTypesNamedPerParameter.ts (4 errors) ====
    // Each invalid variance annotation reports its own marker types (super-U, sub-U, ...), not those
    // of the first annotation checked.
    type A<in T> = { x: T };
           ~~~~
